title: Wall art and lighting: examples and limitations

answer: Photo-based previews can help illustrate wall decor or lighting in context. They do not establish mounting dimensions, brightness, beam pattern or safe installation. Keep those specifications beside the preview.
body:
Keep the question specific

Choose a single scenario and state what the image is intended to help assess. Keep technical specifications separate from the appearance preview.

A practical review checklist

  • Use a photo you have permission to process.
  • Keep the intended placement or body area clearly visible.
  • Compare the generated result against the original images.
  • Explain that a light preview does not measure brightness or safe installation.

AI-generated previews illustrate appearance and placement. They do not provide measured dimensions, guaranteed scale or a live camera-based AR view. Shoppers should check product measurements before buying.

Use the app’s documented workflow

Room Refresh is a Shopify app for furniture and home-decor merchants. Shoppers upload a room photo and generate a preview of a product in that space, directly from a product page.

Start with setup instructions, inspect the current product examples, and check plans and usage charges. Ask support about your specific store before treating an assumption as a product feature.
